note: The company rules library. It is data, not code, and it lives outside the model on purpose: the model retrieves a rule and cites its id, and must never invent one. Add a rule by editing this file.

INTERNAL_HR.label: Internal HR
INTERNAL_HR.purpose: Employee records, payroll and HR processing
INTERNAL_HR.description: HR processes the employee's own record, so identifiers are allowed when they are needed for that processing.

EXTERNAL_VENDOR.label: External Vendor
EXTERNAL_VENDOR.purpose: Repair or service work that requires the complaint and invoice details
EXTERNAL_VENDOR.description: An outside company. It gets what it needs to do the job, and nothing that identifies a person.

ANALYST.label: Analyst
ANALYST.description: Works with totals and trends. Needs business figures, not people.

CUSTOMER_SUPPORT.label: Customer Support
CUSTOMER_SUPPORT.purpose: Handling the customer's case and calling them back
CUSTOMER_SUPPORT.description: Talks to the customer directly, so contact details are allowed, but official identifiers are not.

CUSTOM.label: Custom receiver
CUSTOM.purpose: A receiver with no rules yet
CUSTOM.description: No rules are defined for this receiver, so every sensitive item comes back as ASK_HUMAN. The system does not invent a rule.
